## Goal

Adapt the existing eval test suite to the new campaign-by-default batch so the whole suite stays green and both modes remain covered: `arena.test.ts`, `engine.test.ts`, `cli.test.ts`, `balanceStats.test.ts`, `report.test.ts` (and any test asserting the old skirmish-only default). Also confirm the bot batch and human campaign runs (AH-0MV7WVEWL005XEMN) are directly comparable now that both carry wave/level/upgrade events.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1:** Every existing eval test that assumed a skirmish-only batch is updated (or explicitly scoped to `--skirmish`), and the full source/ai/eval test set passes.
- **AC2:** Both the campaign and skirmish paths are covered by their own tests (spawns, events, report shape for each).
- **AC3:** Where a test asserted `waveReached`/`levelReached`/`upgradesSelected` were empty, it now asserts meaningful non-zero values on the campaign path.
- **AC4:** Bott-vs-human balance-stat comparability is asserted (same schema, both populate wave/level/upgrade fields now) and documented in the relevant test comment.

## Key Files

**Key Files:**
- `src/ai/eval/arena.test.ts` — skirmish vs campaign spawns/events coverage
- `src/ai/eval/engine.test.ts` — batch-default assertions updated
- `src/ai/eval/cli.test.ts` — default/--skirmish CLI assertions updated
- `src/ai/eval/balanceStats.test.ts` — non-zero wave/level/upgrade expectations
- `src/ai/eval/report.test.ts` — report-shape expectations for both modes
- `src/ai/eval/metrics.test.ts` — extraction from campaign streams

# Test: wrapAware config plumbing

Test-first verification slice for the `wrapAware` parameter (parent AH-0MV9G3DZ9003P7P8, AC1 + AC5). Pins the data-driven boolean's default, seed exclusions, CSV wiring and editor exposure **before** the implementation item lands, so the pipeline change is driven by failing tests.

## Goal

Pin the full config pipeline for `wrapAware`: default `true`, `march`/`centipede` seeded `false`, CSV persist + round-trip, editor-panel visibility.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A test asserts a generic archetype resolves `wrapAware === true` when the field is absent from its seed config.
- Tests assert the `march` and `centipede` seed configs carry `wrapAware === false` (the explicit exclusion list).
- A CSV round-trip test asserts a `wrapAware` column persists and reloads through the config CSV path; a missing/empty value falls back to `true`.
- A test asserts the field is enumerable through the existing `EnemyConfig` editor/config plumbing without extra per-field admin.
- All tests pass deterministically (no wall clock, no RNG).

## Key Files

- `src/core/configTypes.ts`
- `src/core/configDefaults.ts`
- `src/data/enemy-configs.csv`
- `src/core/enemyConfig.ts`
- `src/utils/csvEdit.ts`
data.title: Test: wrapAware config plumbing

Commit: 9974a6bf — AH-0MVD1RMV1002L0K9: Implementation complete

Changes:
- balanceStats.test.ts: skirmish extraction now explicitly scoped with `campaign: false`; added a campaign-path test asserting non-zero waveReached/levelReached/upgradesSelected (AC2/AC3).
- metrics.test.ts: added campaign-record-stream extraction coverage (canonical wave_start event + byte-stable metric point) (AC2).
- humanStats.test.ts: synthetic human campaign stream now carries wave_cleared/level_cleared/choice_selected, and a new test asserts bot-vs-human comparability (same schema, both populate progression fields) with the rationale documented in the test comment (AC4).
- report.test.ts: added a report-shape test for both batch modes (populated campaign distributions vs zero skirmish wave/level distributions) (AC2).

Validation: typecheck clean; full project suite (unit + integration) green via the implement finish gate (479s) and a follow-up read-only full run.
